Haifeng Cheng is a student learning PostgreSQL Day-2 operations. He focuses on logical backup and restore, and on the access-control details that travel with a dump: object ownership, ACLs, and default privileges. He builds small reproducible labs to test those behaviours before trusting a restore in a real environment.
